briefdescription.para: Base class for all scheduled JSBSim models.

detaileddescription.para: Each model binds simulation/models/<Name>/enabled (default true), where Name is the name passed to the constructor. Setting that property false skips the model's Run(): its last state and its property bindings are preserved, which is the property-tree mechanism by which an external system can replace a model, for example a host physics engine owning FGGroundReactions. The binding is made at construction, so a model that renames itself while loading does not move its enable property.
